cornerCallouts: Drivers will be battling into the first corner, Castrol Kurve, hoping to gain an advantage.
Navigating the Bosch Kurve requires precision and courage, a true test of nerve.
The Jochen Rindt Kurve is a key overtaking opportunity, named after the Austrian legend.
Through the Hella-Licht Kurve, the drivers need to carry maximum speed to set up the next straight.
The Omv Kurve is a challenging corner that can easily catch drivers out.
The last corner, the Ziel Kurve, is crucial for setting up a strong run to the finish line.
The long straight after the Jochen Rindt Kurve will give the cars a chance to stretch their legs.
The Flugplatz section is always exciting, with the cars briefly taking flight over the crest.
strategyPoints: Tire management will be crucial on this abrasive surface, especially with the high-speed corners of the Historic 1977 layout.
The extended length of this 5.942km circuit means fuel consumption will be a significant factor.
A well-timed pit stop could be the key to victory, but the pit lane length adds to the challenge.
The long straights offer opportunities for overtaking, but also put a strain on the engines.
With the increased lap length, the pit window is slightly more forgiving than on the modern layout.
Teams will be closely monitoring tire degradation throughout the race, looking for the optimal moment to pit.
Fuel strategy will be a delicate balance, pushing hard without running dry in the closing laps.
The undulating nature of the track adds to the complexity of the race strategy, making it a real chess game.
weatherCommentary: The Styrian mountains can bring unpredictable weather, sunshine one minute, rain the next.
The altitude here can affect engine performance, especially if the air is thin and dry.
Keep an eye on those clouds gathering over the mountains; a sudden downpour could shake things up.
The wind can be a factor here, especially at the top of the hill, affecting the car's balance.
The temperature can fluctuate dramatically throughout the day, impacting tire grip and performance.
